prompts.name: reception
prompts.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: original full-width website carousel interior photograph for a premium Chinese pet grooming boutique.
Style: photorealistic high-end architectural interior photography of a contemporary upscale Chinese pet grooming boutique, elegant restrained Shanghai/Hangzhou urban luxury.
Shared interior identity: warm ivory microcement walls, light natural oak cabinetry with rounded corners, pale travertine surfaces, small subtle terracotta accents and muted sage accessories. Soft daylight with concealed warm lighting, clean practical pet-safe space and premium realistic materials.
Camera/composition: landscape 16:9, approximately 1536x864, architectural wide angle 24mm eye-level, straight verticals, balanced spacious composition and realistic scale, publication quality.
Constraints: no people, no text, no logos, no watermarks, no collages. Generate exactly ONE image.
Scene: Welcoming reception and waiting lounge. Curved travertine reception counter, built-in oak product display niches holding tasteful unbranded pet retail items such as leashes, collars and pet-care bottles, cream lounge seating, subtle bonsai and understated Chinese aesthetic. Clearly a pet boutique. Warm inviting clean entrance space.
